deliverables: Cardano title sponsorship for Rare Evo 2026 main stage and global livestream
Cardano title sponsorship for Rare Dev Gov Day 2026 on July 28, 2026 at ARIA Las Vegas
Free General Admission access for the Cardano community
Complimentary booth space for selected Cardano ecosystem startup projects
Five Cardano-focused main stage panelist positions
Tier 1 media coverage for Cardano ecosystem announcements
Travel and lodging support for 20 Cardano ecosystem contributors or volunteers
Return of 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury
request.what: Rare Network requests Cardano treasury funding for Cardano title sponsorship of Rare Evo 2026 and Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026 in Las Vegas, including main stage branding, livestream integration, governance programming, workshops, startup showcases, media coverage, community onboarding, free access, booth space, travel/lodging support, and related fees.

claims.claim: Rare Network requests ₳2,750,000, stated as $660,000 at a $0.24 ADA valuation, to fund two Cardano sponsorship packages for Rare Evo 2026 and Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026.
The proposal states that 20% of all VIP ticket sales, with current VIP ticket retail value of $900, will be returned to the Cardano Treasury.
Rare Network states it has been active in the Cardano ecosystem since 2020 and has operated Rare Evo annually for five consecutive years.

The proposal reports Rare Evo 2025 metrics including 2,500 annual attendees, 80 exhibitor booths, 85 speakers, 100+ ecosystem partners, 20K+ livestream views, 4M social media impressions, 40+ Cardano projects represented, and 50+ enterprise participants.

The proposal states Cardano Dev Gov Day 2025 was free and publicly accessible, welcomed approximately 500 attendees, and included workshops, panels, networking, technical education, governance discussions, and a Charles Hoskinson keynote.

The proposal claims the existing Rare Network infrastructure, venue relationships, sponsor network, production capabilities, volunteer coordination, and industry partnerships significantly reduce execution risk compared with building a new initiative from scratch.

The cost breakdown allocates ₳1,166,666.67 for Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026 sponsorship, ₳833,333.33 for Rare Evo 2026 Cardano title sponsorship, and ₳750,000 for Intersect, audit, fees, tax withholdings, and a Dev Gov Day 2027 deposit.

The proposal says sponsorship allocation may change if the mainstage or livestream package is purchased before the vote passes, in which case Cardano would receive a sponsorship of equal impact or dollar value.

The proposal says selection processes for speaking opportunities, booth space, volunteer participation, and travel/lodging assistance will prioritize active ecosystem contributors and applicants able to provide educational or ecosystem value.

The proposal asserts alignment with governance, community and ecosystem growth, and ecosystem sustainability pillars by expanding governance programming, free participation, contributor attendance, workshops, livestream/media distribution, and broader multi-chain industry engagement.

summary: The anchor asks for ₳2.75M for Cardano title sponsorships at Rare Evo 2026 and Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026, supported by event-history claims, attendance and reach metrics, a cost breakdown, free access and participation benefits, and a proposed VIP-ticket revenue return, but several important treasury diligence areas are not developed in the supplied assessment.
